description_en: Queries the information about a packaging job
description_zh: 获取单个打包任务信息
name: GetPackageJob

parameters.help_en: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461964.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461964.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

PackageJob.description_en: The information about the packaging job

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the job fails

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the job was complete. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
FinishTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Input.description_en: The information about the input stream file
